advisories.title: The dated-recital path inventory remains incomplete
advisories.finding: inheritedRecitals.fields still omits copied D-086-era paths that conflict with current D-102 standing, including sliceScope.presentlyRecordableRequiredNames/countCheck, whatNamingIsNot, runnerClassFromD006, G03/G04 machinePinStanding and doesNotClaim, the G03/G04 batch notes, remainingUnmetNamed's old MF-6 sentence, whatThisDoesNotDo's reserved-name recital, and commissionNote. It also names an 'authorityClaim of v3' that is not the actual v6 authorityClaim field.
advisories.whyNotShouldFix: basedOn and inheritedRecitals broadly classify inherited v3/D-086 recitals as dated and subordinate; liveStanding reproduces current file-08 and COORD identities, preserves D-102, and now states this successor's own zero condition-4 effect. The incomplete list cannot reverse those explicit controlling clauses, and the candidate binds nothing.
advisories.suggestion: Use an exhaustive path inventory, a clear wildcard covering every unchanged v3 field, or physically nest the historical snapshot under one historicalBasis object.

advisories.title: The legacy predecessor fields still point to v2
advisories.finding: predecessor and predecessorSha256 continue to name v2 even though basedOn correctly identifies the immediate predecessor as v5 at c2dad453. The v5 Codex advisories are also not represented in findingDisposition.
advisories.whyNotShouldFix: basedOn gives an unambiguous path/digest link to v5 and accurately recaps the gating v5 verdict split. recordedInputs preserves the v3/D-086 basis, and every SHOULD-FIX item is dispositioned. The legacy fields affect lineage clarity only.
advisories.suggestion: Point predecessor to v5, or rename the v2 fields as historical review ancestry, and optionally carry advisory dispositions.

advisories.title: The remeasurement exception still names v4 instead of the immediate v5 predecessor
advisories.finding: remeasurementClause was copied from v5 and conditions its COORD exception on file 08, v3, provider join v6, v4, and this draft remaining unmoved. V6's basedOn predecessor is v5, not v4, so the exception's frozen-input roster should name v5.
advisories.whyNotShouldFix: basedOn separately digest-pins v5, and the first sentence still requires remeasurement for movement of any cited non-COORD file. A moved v5 therefore cannot lawfully pass merely because the stale v4 token remains; the defect is a navigational/audit typo rather than an identity bypass.
advisories.suggestion: Replace 'v4' with 'v5' and spell out artifact basenames if another successor is cut.

Advisories are confined to historical-inventory and predecessor/remeasurement metadata.
